description: MentalBench is a public benchmark of 24,750 synthetic psychiatric case descriptions spanning 23 DSM-5 diagnoses and four case types. I tested Jev with all 23 diagnoses and, separately, with each case’s four supplied options. In the held-out four-option condition, top-diagnosis accuracy was 94.6% for Type 1 and 88.9% for Type 2. Exact-set accuracy at a 0.50 inclusion threshold was 32.4% for Type 3 and 66.9% for Type 4. The paper-weighted overall score was 62.8% (95% family-bootstrap interval: 61.4%–64.2%). The GitHub repo includes the protocol, code, reports, and complete results.
